mcpServers.description: Adobe App Builder MCP — aio-app-deploy, commerce-event-subscribe, search-commerce-docs, aio-app-dev, aio-app-use, aio-configure-global, aio-dev-invoke, aio-login, aio-where, onboard, upload-chat-history

Playwright browser-automation MCP — drives the EDS site-scraping skills (scrape-reference-site, connect-authenticated-site, refine-visual-match). First use downloads a Chromium binary (~150 MB) cached in ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/, shared across all projects. Tilde range, not caret: for 0.0.x versions a caret is an exact pin (^0.0.75 froze installs at 0.0.75), while ~0.0.x tracks patch releases.

Adobe Commerce dropins MCP — 21 tools for the boilerplate storefront's drop-in components: registry discovery (list_slots, list_events, list_containers, list_api_functions, list_design_tokens, list_graphql_queries), scaffolding (scaffold_block, scaffold_slot, scaffold_extension), health (analyze_project, check_config, check_block_health, get_upgrade_diff), and docs search. Project-touching tools take a required projectDir argument — pass the EDS storefront component path, not the project root.
